title: Public Comment Period Closes on Proposed Section 301 Forced-Labor Tariffs on 60 Economies
detail: The public comment period closed on USTR's proposed Section 301 tariffs targeting 60 economies over forced-labor import practices, first proposed June 2 as the administration's legal fallback for when Section 122 tariff authority expires on July 24. Treasury yields were little changed on the day as investors looked ahead to the upcoming FOMC minutes release.
